concept.title: Exclude files from version control
concept.shortdesc: Exclude untracked files and folders from Git version control by adding them to the project .gitignore or global ignore file.

conbody.p: Add files and folders to the project .gitignore automatically using built-in actions and open the project .gitignore and global .ignore file.
Built-in actions add the paths of untracked files and folders to the end of the project's .gitignore.

Once you add a path to either ignore file, the associated file or folder no longer appears on Git Staging. To re-enable change tracking of a file or folder, remove its path from the project .gitignore or global .ignore file.
The following sections provide step-by-step instructions for each available action, including opening ignore files.
conbody.note: Once a file or folder becomes tracked, you can no longer exclude it from Git version control.
